LanguageData.VGE_GravFieldAmplifier.label: lift-field amplifier
LanguageData.VGE_GravFieldAmplifier.description: A high-output REPCONN field amplifier that extends a Hellion reactor's lift envelope, increasing both the buildable area and the amount of deck plating it can support. It must be installed near the reactor, and no Hellion can support more than four.
LanguageData.VGE_SmallHeatsink.description: A compact thermal regulator that absorbs heat produced by Hellion travel, shortens reactor cooldown, and converts part of the waste heat into electricity. A Hellion can support up to ten.
LanguageData.VGE_LargeHeatsink.description: A large thermal regulator that absorbs heat produced by Hellion travel, shortens reactor cooldown, and converts part of the waste heat into electricity. A Hellion can support up to six.
LanguageData.VGE_GravheatAbsorber.label: reactor heat absorber
LanguageData.VGE_GravheatAbsorber.description: An emergency thermal sink that purges residual heat from the Hellion reactor and immediately clears its launch cooldown. The unit then requires a long recovery period, but its heavy shielding also protects the interior from solar-flare heat.
LanguageData.VGE_EngineeringConsole.description: A diagnostic console for monitoring every maintainable component aboard a Hellion. It draws power from the reactor and reduces maintenance sensitivity across the connected airframe.
LanguageData.VGE_GravtechConsole.label: Hellion telemetry console
LanguageData.VGE_GravtechConsole.description: A REPCONN analysis console used to process flight data recorded during Hellion launches and travel. It draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBlackBox.label: Hellion flight recorder
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBlackBox.description: A hardened pre-War flight recorder integrated into the Hellion's systems. It increases flight-data yield, captures overflow, and can convert stored telemetry into ordinary research progress. A Hellion can support only one recorder.
LanguageData.VGE_FlightComputer.description: A REPCONN guidance computer that optimizes sensor logging during Hellion travel, increasing the flight data recorded by each launch.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipScannerCluster.label: Hellion scanner cluster
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipScannerCluster.description: A multi-frequency REPCONN sensor array capable of searching underground, scanning distant surface regions, or tracking orbital objects. Detection speed depends on the operator's research ability. It draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipStructuralBeam.label: Hellion structural beam
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipStructuralBeam.description: A reinforced airframe beam around which Hellion deck plating can be built. It extends the construction area in a five-by-five square; destroying it can collapse adjacent beams.
LanguageData.VGE_GunnerSubpersonaCore.label: RobCo fire-control core
LanguageData.VGE_GunnerSubpersonaCore.description: A hardened RobCo targeting computer adapted for Hellion combat. It can autonomously control one linked artillery piece with greater accuracy than most human gunners. A Hellion can support up to two such cores.
LanguageData.VGE_MaintenanceHub.label: automated maintenance hub
LanguageData.VGE_MaintenanceHub.description: A centralized RobCo diagnostic and service system that automates routine upkeep throughout the Hellion, reducing maintenance decay while powered.
LanguageData.VGE_Gravlift.label: Hellion launch cradle
LanguageData.VGE_Gravlift.description: A massive launch-and-stabilization platform integrated into a Hellion airframe. Its thrust system enables vertical takeoff and orbital insertion while reducing damage during emergency landings.
LanguageData.VGE_Compressed_Plasteel.label: compressed Saturnite
LanguageData.VGE_Compressed_Plasteel.description: An ultra-dense Saturnite-bearing mass formed under vacuum and radiation. Exceptionally hard to mine, it is found only in deep orbital deposits.
LanguageData.VGE_Filth_DamagedSubstructure.descriptio: Debris from damaged Hellion deck plating.
LanguageData.VQEA_DestroyedSmallOxygenTank.descriptio: A ruptured Hellion oxygen tank. It can no longer hold pressure, but some metal remains salvageable.
LanguageData.VQEA_DestroyedGravExtender.description: A shattered Hellion lift-field amplifier with a few valuable components still intact.
LanguageData.VQEA_DestroyedSmallThruster.description: A wrecked Hellion thruster stripped of most useful parts. Some metal can still be recovered.
LanguageData.VQEA_DestroyedLargeThruster.description: The remains of a heavy Hellion thruster. Even ruined, its reinforced housing contains useful salvage.
LanguageData.VQEA_DestroyedSmallHeatsink.description: A burned-out Hellion heat sink with recoverable metal in its casing.
